checks.name: Original bodies, native full boundary, directions, coefficient sides, exact small-molecule balances and total net, ionic bridges and genome translations
Original carrier/free threonine/product stereochemistry and reactive fragment comparison

scientific_assessment: Complete source-defined 9+3 reaction boundary is retained. The existing DHB precursor module does not cover the complete NRPS pathway. No uptake, iron loading, or mutasynthetic side products are silently included.

Primary 2025 whole main text, relevant SI text and Figures 1/5/Table S1 were checked against original PDF. Reviewer independently extracted all 30 pages with mutool and visually inspected PDF pages 4,8,19; no all-pages visual inspection claim.

Upstream DhbA/C/B assignments remain explicitly annotation-based. Methods identify the KH3-4 gene sources for the purified NRPS/PPTase preparations. Seven original AP025627 chromosome intervals translate exactly to versioned proteins; this is not full engineered construct-sequence verification.

The printed coexpression DhbB forward-primer suffix maps to DhbE, not DhbB, on the exact retained sequences. The draft already preserves this limitation without declaring that the physical plasmid was wrong.

The original native arginyl intermediate is not renamed. The selected independently issued MetaNetX threonyl class is visibly distinguished from the inconsistent old native equation; no old MetaCyc or ModelSEED exact equivalence is asserted.

Independent structure matching confirms S,R threonyl alpha/beta centers in MNXM743865, native free L-threonine and all three units in native bacillibactin. Formula and charge agree with the source-issued structures. This does not establish a particular whole protein sequence or independently measure every covalent intermediate.
Nine ATP per trimer follows the three adenylations per repeat and exact formal net, not a measured ATP/product ratio. The old six-ATP composite is explicitly excluded and documented.

PPTase activation of DhbB has direct mass-shift/control support; DhbF activation is more indirectly supported by coexpression/productive reconstitution, correctly qualified. MbtH presence, Mg-containing buffer and purification methods do not establish obligatory dependency or fixed assembly.
remaining_limits: One confirmed minor source-locator finding must be corrected and independently rechecked before a clean formal scientific disposition.
Native generic carrier classes lack complete whole-polypeptide formulae; conditional common reactive-fragment bookkeeping is explicitly not whole-protein atom balance or physical stoichiometry.
